    Profile

    Kanon is a super vivacious girl, and she's an apprentice of the Holy Guard. She's an orphan who was raised by the Holy Order, and that's why she idolizes the Holy Guard, the Guardians of the Continent, more than anyone else. She isn't very confident when it comes to Alchemy, but she's very confident at fighting for the bread at her dormitory.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: ―
    Weight: ―
    Birthday: Jul 16
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Shimmering Dragon
    Likes: Sweet and cute things
    Hobbies: Enjoying a large bath
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 伊瀬茉莉也
